verdict.rationale: The evidence clearly supports self-hosting the core product. The GitHub README says agents run 'locally, in Docker, on VMs, or anywhere you can run an agent server backend'. The pricing page lists a free, local OpenHands with web GUI, TUI and CLI. The docs describe a deployable `openhands-agent-server`, an Apptainer sandbox option for HPC, and an open-source Agent Canvas client, and Cloud is positioned as the alternative to operating your own backend. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, detailed self-hosting install/ops documentation, and explicit evidence of the open-source license terms (Enterprise mentions separately 'licensed self-hosting').
